theorems.name: ATK.Cert.IC.mem_smul

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.IC.mem_sub

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.IC.mem_widen
theorems.statement: ∀ {z : ℂ} {I : ATK.Cert.IC} {e : ℚ}, ATK.Cert.IC.mem z I → 0 ≤ e → ATK.Cert.IC.mem z (I.widen e)

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.IC.mem_widen_of_norm
theorems.statement: ∀ {z w : ℂ} {I : ATK.Cert.IC} {e : ℚ}, ATK.Cert.IC.mem w I → ‖z - w‖ ≤ ↑e → ATK.Cert.IC.mem z (I.widen e)

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.IC.mk.inj
theorems.statement: ∀ {re im re_1 im_1 : ATK.Cert.IR}, { re := re, im := im } = { re := re_1, im := im_1 } → re = re_1 ∧ im = im_1

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.IC.mk.injEq
theorems.statement: ∀ (re im re_1 im_1 : ATK.Cert.IR), ({ re := re, im := im } = { re := re_1, im := im_1 }) = (re = re_1 ∧ im = im_1)

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.IC.mk.sizeOf_spec
theorems.statement: ∀ (re im : ATK.Cert.IR), sizeOf { re := re, im := im } = 1 + sizeOf re + sizeOf im

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.IC.norm_le_normMax
theorems.statement: ∀ {z : ℂ} {I : ATK.Cert.IC}, ATK.Cert.IC.mem z I → ‖z‖ ≤ ↑I.normMax

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.IC.smul.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (K : ATK.Cert.IR) (I : ATK.Cert.IC), ATK.Cert.IC.smul K I = { re := K.mul I.re, im := K.mul I.im }

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.IR.mem.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (x : ℝ) (I : ATK.Cert.IR), ATK.Cert.IR.mem x I = (↑I.lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ ↑I.hi)

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.IR.mem_add
theorems.statement: ∀ {x y : ℝ} {I J : ATK.Cert.IR}, ATK.Cert.IR.mem x I → ATK.Cert.IR.mem y J → ATK.Cert.IR.mem (x + y) (I.add J)

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.IR.mem_inv
theorems.statement: ∀ {x : ℝ} {I : ATK.Cert.IR}, ATK.Cert.IR.mem x I → 0 < I.lo → ATK.Cert.IR.mem x⁻¹ I.inv

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.IR.mem_mul
theorems.statement: ∀ {x y : ℝ} {I J : ATK.Cert.IR}, ATK.Cert.IR.mem x I → ATK.Cert.IR.mem y J → ATK.Cert.IR.mem (x * y) (I.mul J)

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.IR.mem_neg
theorems.statement: ∀ {x : ℝ} {I : ATK.Cert.IR}, ATK.Cert.IR.mem x I → ATK.Cert.IR.mem (-x) I.neg

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.IR.mem_pt

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.IR.mem_round
theorems.statement: ∀ {x : ℝ} {I : ATK.Cert.IR} (p : ℕ), ATK.Cert.IR.mem x I → ATK.Cert.IR.mem x (ATK.Cert.IR.round p I)

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.IR.min_le_mul
theorems.statement: ∀ {a b x y : ℝ}, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → min (a * y) (b * y) ≤ x * y

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.IR.mk.inj

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.IR.mk.injEq

theorems.statement: ∀ (lo hi : ℚ), sizeOf { lo := lo, hi := hi } = 1 + sizeOf lo + sizeOf hi

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.IR.mul_le_max
theorems.statement: ∀ {a b x y : ℝ}, a ≤ x → x ≤ b → x * y ≤ max (a * y) (b * y)

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.atS_cast
theorems.statement: ∀ (K : ℕ) (q : ℚ), ↑(ATK.Cert.atS K q) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, 2 * (1 / (2 * ↑k + 1)) * ↑q ^ (2 * k + 1)

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.logI.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (K : ℕ), ATK.Cert.logI K 0 = { lo := 0, hi := 0 }

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.logI.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (K : ℕ), ATK.Cert.logI K 1 = { lo := 0, hi := 0 }

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.logI.eq_3
theorems.statement: ∀ (K j : ℕ), ATK.Cert.logI K j.succ.succ = (ATK.Cert.logI K (j + 1)).add (ATK.Cert.dLog K (j + 1))

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.logI.eq_def
theorems.statement: ∀ (K x : ℕ),   ATK.Cert.logI K x =     match x with     | 0 => { lo := 0, hi := 0 }     | 1 => { lo := 0, hi := 0 }     | j.succ.succ => (ATK.Cert.logI K (j + 1)).add (ATK.Cert.dLog K (j + 1))

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.lt_piLo_add
theorems.statement: Real.pi < ↑ATK.Cert.piLo + 1 / 10 ^ 20

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.mem_dLog

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.mem_expIAuto

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.norm_expI_sub_le

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.piLo_lt
theorems.statement: ↑ATK.Cert.piLo < Real.pi

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.tayI.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (x : ℚ), ATK.Cert.tayI 0 x = ((0, 0), 1, 0)

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.tayI.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (x : ℚ) (n : ℕ),   ATK.Cert.tayI n.succ x =     (((ATK.Cert.tayI n x).1.1 + (ATK.Cert.tayI n x).2.1, (ATK.Cert.tayI n x).1.2 + (ATK.Cert.tayI n x).2.2),       -((ATK.Cert.tayI n x).2.2 * x) / (↑n + 1), (ATK.Cert.tayI n x).2.1 * x / (↑n + 1))

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.tayI.eq_def
theorems.statement: ∀ (x : ℕ) (x_1 : ℚ),   ATK.Cert.tayI x x_1 =     match x, x_1 with     | 0, x => ((0, 0), 1, 0)     | n.succ, m =>       have r := ATK.Cert.tayI n m;       ((r.1.1 + r.2.1, r.1.2 + r.2.2), -(r.2.2 * m) / (↑n + 1), r.2.1 * m / (↑n + 1))

theorems.name: ATK.Cert.tayI_spec
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (m : ℚ),   ↑(ATK.Cert.tayI n m).1.1 + ↑(ATK.Cert.tayI n m).1.2 * Complex.I =       ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (Complex.I * ↑m) ^ k / ↑k.factorial ∧     ↑(ATK.Cert.tayI n m).2.1 + ↑(ATK.Cert.tayI n m).2.2 * Complex.I = (Complex.I * ↑m) ^ n / ↑n.factorial

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.brecOn.eq

theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (a a_1 a_2 a_3 : ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form ι), (a.e a_1 = a_2.e a_3) = (a = a_2 ∧ a_1 = a_3)

theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (x : List (ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form ι)),   ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eL x =     match x with     | [] => ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.tt     | φ :: φs => φ.e (ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eL φs)

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (ρ : ι → Bool) (i : ι), ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval ρ (ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.var i) = ρ i

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (ρ : ι → Bool), ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval ρ ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.tt = true

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval.eq_3
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (ρ : ι → Bool), ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval ρ ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.ff = false

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval.eq_4
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (ρ : ι → Bool) (a b : ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form ι),   ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval ρ (a.e b) = (ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval ρ a && ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval ρ b)

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval.eq_5
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (ρ : ι → Bool) (a b : ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form ι),   ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval ρ (a.ou b) = (ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval ρ a || ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval ρ b)

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval.eq_6
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (ρ : ι → Bool) (a : ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form ι),   ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval ρ a.nao = !ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval ρ a

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval.eq_def
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (ρ : ι → Bool) (x : ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form ι),   ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval ρ x =     match x with     | ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.var i => ρ i     | ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.tt => true     | ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.ff => false     | a.e b => ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval ρ a && ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval ρ b     | a.ou b => ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval ρ a || ATK.Circuit

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval_const
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (ρ : ι → Bool) (b : Bool), ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval ρ (ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.const b) = b

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval_eL
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (ρ : ι → Bool) (φs : List (ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form ι)),   ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval ρ (ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eL φs) = true ↔     ∀ φ ∈ φs, ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval ρ φ = true

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval_ouL

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.ff.sizeOf_spec
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : SizeOf ι], sizeOf ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.ff = 1

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.nao.inj
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {a a_1 : ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form ι}, a.nao = a_1.nao → a = a_1

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.nao.injEq
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (a a_1 : ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form ι), (a.nao = a_1.nao) = (a = a_1)

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.nao.sizeOf_spec
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : SizeOf ι] (a : ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form ι), sizeOf a.nao = 1 + sizeOf a

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.ou.inj
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {a a_1 a_2 a_3 : ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form ι}, a.ou a_1 = a_2.ou a_3 → a = a_2 ∧ a_1 = a_3

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.ou.injEq
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (a a_1 a_2 a_3 : ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form ι), (a.ou a_1 = a_2.ou a_3) = (a = a_2 ∧ a_1 = a_3)

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.ou.sizeOf_spec
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : SizeOf ι] (a a_1 : ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form ι), sizeOf (a.ou a_1) = 1 + sizeOf a + sizeOf a_1

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.ouL.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1}, ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.ouL [] = ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.ff

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.ouL.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (φ : ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form ι) (φs : List (ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form ι)),   ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.ouL (φ :: φs) = φ.ou (ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.ouL φs)

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.ouL.eq_def
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (x : List (ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form ι)),   ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.ouL x =     match x with     | [] => ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.ff     | φ :: φs => φ.ou (ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.ouL φs)

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.tam.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (i : ι), (ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.var i).tam = 0

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.tam.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1}, ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.tt.tam = 1

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.tam.eq_3
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1}, ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.ff.tam = 1

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.tam.eq_4
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (a b : ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form ι), (a.e b).tam = a.tam + b.tam + 1

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.tam.eq_5
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (a b : ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form ι), (a.ou b).tam = a.tam + b.tam + 1

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.tam.eq_6
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (a : ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form ι), a.nao.tam = a.tam + 1

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.tam.eq_def
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (x : ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form ι),   x.tam =     match x with     | ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.var a => 0     | ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.tt => 1     | ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.ff => 1     | a.e b => a.tam + b.tam + 1     | a.ou b => a.tam + b.tam + 1     | a.nao => a.tam + 1

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.tam_const
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (b : Bool), (ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.const b).tam = 1

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.tam_eL

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.tam_ouL

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.var.injEq
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (a a_1 : ι), (ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.var a = ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.var a_1) = (a = a_1)

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.var.sizeOf_spec

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.avalia_append
theorems.statement: ∀ (G H : List ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Porta) (v : List Bool),   ATK.Shannon.avalia (G ++ H) v = ATK.Shannon.avalia H (ATK.Shannon.avalia G v)

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.avalia_bloco
theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (idx : ι → ℕ) (φs : List (ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form ι)) (v : List Bool),   (∀ (i : ι), idx i < v.length) →     ∃ w,       ATK.Shannon.avalia (ATK.CircuitoCamadas.bloco idx v.length φs) v =           v ++ w ++ List.map (fun φ => ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.eval (fun i => v.getD (idx i) false) φ) φs ∧         w.length = (List.map ATK.CircuitoCamadas.Form.tam φs).sum

theorems.name: ATK.CircuitoCamadas.avalia_comp

theorems.name: ATK.Compilador.sem.eq_9

theorems.statement: ∀ {R : ℕ} (f₀ f₁ : ATK.Compilador.Env R → ATK.Compilador.Env R × List Bool) (x : ATK.Compilador.Env R) (b : Bool)   (bs : List Bool),   ATK.Compilador.semBits f₀ f₁ (b :: bs) x =     ((ATK.Compilador.semBits f₀ f₁ bs ((if b = true then f₁ else f₀) x).1).1,       ((if b = true then f₁ else f₀) x).2 ++ (ATK.Compilador.semBits f₀ f₁ bs ((if b = true then f₁ else f₀) x).1).2)

theorems.name: ATK.Compilador.semBits.eq_def
theorems.statement: ∀ {R : ℕ} (f₀ f₁ : ATK.Compilador.Env R → ATK.Compilador.Env R × List Bool) (x : List Bool)   (x_1 : ATK.Compilador.Env R),   ATK.Compilador.semBits f₀ f₁ x x_1 =     match x, x_1 with     | [], E => (E, [])     | b :: bs, E =>       have r₁ := (if b = true then f₁ else f₀) E;       have r₂ := ATK.Compilador.semBits f₀ f₁ bs r₁.1;       (r₂.1, r₁.2 ++ r₂.2)

theorems.name: ATK.Compilador.semFor.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ {R : ℕ} (f : ATK.Compilador.Env R → ATK.Compilador.Env R × List Bool) (y : Fin R) (x : ATK.Compilador.Env R),   ATK.Compilador.semFor f y 0 x = (x, [])

theorems.name: ATK.Compilador.semFor.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ {R : ℕ} (f : ATK.Compilador.Env R → ATK.Compilador.Env R × List Bool) (y : Fin R) (x : ATK.Compilador.Env R) (m : ℕ),   ATK.Compilador.semFor f y m.succ x =     ((ATK.Compilador.semFor f y m (Function.update (f x).1 y ((f x).1 y + 1))).1,       (f x).2 ++ (ATK.Compilador.semFor f y m (Function.update (f x).1 y ((f x).1 y + 1))).2)

theorems.name: ATK.Compilador.semFor.eq_def
theorems.statement: ∀ {R : ℕ} (f : ATK.Compilador.Env R → ATK.Compilador.Env R × List Bool) (y : Fin R) (x : ℕ)   (x_1 : ATK.Compilador.Env R),   ATK.Compilador.semFor f y x x_1 =     match x, x_1 with     | 0, E => (E, [])     | m.succ, E =>       have r₁ := f E;       have r₂ := ATK.Compilador.semFor f y m (Function.update r₁.1 y (r₁.1 y + 1));       (r₂.1, r₁.2 ++ r₂.2)

theorems.name: ATK.Compilador.sem_unario
theorems.statement: ∀ (w : List Bool), (ATK.Compilador.sem w ATK.Compilador.progUnario fun x => 0).2 = List.replicate w.length true

theorems.name: ATK.Compilador.stepAux_pushesBit
theorems.statement: ∀ {R A : ℕ} (ds : List (ATK.Compilador.Pilha R A)),   ds.Nodup →     ∀ (a : Bool) (S : ATK.Compilador.Stk R A),       Turing.TM2.stepAux (ATK.Compilador.pushesBit ds) (some a) S =         { l := some (), var := some a, stk := fun k => if k ∈ ds then a :: S k else S k }

theorems.name: ATK.Compilador.stepAux_pushesOut
theorems.statement: ∀ {R A : ℕ} (s : List Bool) (v : Option Bool) (S : ATK.Compilador.Stk R A),   Turing.TM2.stepAux (ATK.Compilador.pushesOut s) v S =     { l := some (), var := none,       stk := Function.update S ATK.Compilador.Pilha.out (s.reverse ++ S ATK.Compilador.Pilha.out) }

theorems.name: ATK.Compilador.stmtInc.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ {R A : ℕ} (x : Fin R),   ATK.Compilador.stmtInc x =     Turing.TM2.Stmt.push (ATK.Compilador.Pilha.reg x) (fun x => true)       (Turing.TM2.Stmt.load (fun x => none) (Turing.TM2.Stmt.goto fun x => ()))

theorems.name: ATK.Compilador.stmtLen.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ {R A : ℕ} (x : Fin R),   ATK.Compilador.stmtLen x =     Turing.TM2.Stmt.push ATK.Compilador.Pilha.bak (fun v => v.getD false)       (Turing.TM2.Stmt.push (ATK.Compilador.Pilha.reg x) (fun x => true) (Turing.TM2.Stmt.goto fun x => ()))

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.cfgA.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (r : M₂.σ × Option Bool) (c : Turing.TM2.Cfg M₁.Γ M₁.Λ M₁.σ),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.cfgA M₁ M₂ r c =     { l := ATK.ComposicaoTM2.labA M₁ M₂ c.l, var := (c.var, r), stk := ATK.ComposicaoTM2.stkA M₁ M₂ c.stk }

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.cfgB.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (s₁ : M₁.σ) (c : Turing.TM2.Cfg M₂.Γ M₂.Λ M₂.σ),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.cfgB M₁ M₂ s₁ c =     { l := Option.map (fun l => Sum.inr (Sum.inl l)) c.l, var := (s₁, c.var, none),       stk := ATK.ComposicaoTM2.stkB M₁ M₂ c.stk }

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.cfgT.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (l : ATK.ComposicaoTM2.Λc M₁ M₂) (s₁ : M₁.σ) (s₂ : M₂.σ) (L : List (M₁.Γ M₁.k₁))   (A : List Bool) (B : List (M₂.Γ M₂.k₀)),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.cfgT M₁ M₂ l s₁ s₂ L A B =     { l := some l, var := (s₁, s₂, none), stk := ATK.ComposicaoTM2.stkT M₁ M₂ L A B }

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.compTM.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (e₁ : M₁.Γ M₁.k₁ → Bool) (e₂ : Bool → M₂.Γ M₂.k₀),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.compTM M₁ M₂ e₁ e₂ =     { K := ATK.ComposicaoTM2.Kc M₁ M₂, kDecidableEq := fun a b => instDecidableEqSum a b,       kFin := instFintypeSum M₁.K (M₂.K ⊕ Unit), k₀ := Sum.inl M₁.k₀, k₁ := Sum.inr (Sum.inl M₂.k₁),       Γ := ATK.ComposicaoTM2.Γc M₁ M₂, Λ := ATK.ComposicaoTM2.Λc M₁ M₂, main := Sum.inl M₁.

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.cotaSaida.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ {α β αΓ : Type} {ea : α → List αΓ} {eb : β → List Bool} {f : α → β} (hf : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime ea eb f),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.cotaSaida hf = Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C (ATK.ComposicaoTM2.pushMax hf.tm.m) * hf.time

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.eval_mono
theorems.statement: ∀ (p : Polynomial ℕ) {a b : ℕ}, a ≤ b → Polynomial.eval a p ≤ Polynomial.eval b p

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.haltList_comp
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (e₁ : M₁.Γ M₁.k₁ → Bool) (e₂ : Bool → M₂.Γ M₂.k₀) (z : List (M₂.Γ M₂.k₁)),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.cfgB M₁ M₂ M₁.initialState (Turing.haltList M₂ z) =     Turing.haltList (ATK.ComposicaoTM2.compTM M₁ M₂ e₁ e₂) z

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.haltList_fase1
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (y : List (M₁.Γ M₁.k₁)),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.cfgA M₁ M₂ (M₂.initialState, none) (Turing.haltList M₁ y) =     ATK.ComposicaoTM2.cfgT M₁ M₂ (ATK.ComposicaoTM2.t₁ M₁ M₂) M₁.initialState M₂.initialState y [] []

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.initList_comp
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (e₁ : M₁.Γ M₁.k₁ → Bool) (e₂ : Bool → M₂.Γ M₂.k₀) (x : List (M₁.Γ M₁.k₀)),   Turing.initList (ATK.ComposicaoTM2.compTM M₁ M₂ e₁ e₂) x =     ATK.ComposicaoTM2.cfgA M₁ M₂ (M₂.initialState, none) (Turing.initList M₁ x)

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.initList_fase2
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (B : List (M₂.Γ M₂.k₀)),   { l := some (Sum.inr (Sum.inl M₂.main)), var := (M₁.initialState, M₂.initialState, none),       stk := ATK.ComposicaoTM2.stkT M₁ M₂ [] [] B } =     ATK.ComposicaoTM2.cfgB M₁ M₂ M₁.initialState (Turing.initList M₂ B)

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.iterate_none
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (f : α → Option α) (n : ℕ), (flip bind f)^[n] none = none

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.iterate_sim
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (f : α → Option α) (g : β → Option β) (φ : α → β),   (∀ (a : α), f a ≠ none → g (φ a) = Option.map φ (f a)) →     ∀ (n : ℕ) (a b : α), (flip bind f)^[n] (some a) = some b → (flip bind g)^[n] (some (φ a)) = some (φ b)

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.labA.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2), ATK.ComposicaoTM2.labA M₁ M₂ none = some (ATK.ComposicaoTM2.t₁ M₁ M₂)

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.labA.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (l : M₁.Λ), ATK.ComposicaoTM2.labA M₁ M₂ (some l) = some (Sum.inl l)

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (k : M₁.K) (f : M₁.σ → M₁.Γ k) (q : Turing.TM2.Stmt M₁.Γ M₁.Λ M₁.σ),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA M₁ M₂ (Turing.TM2.Stmt.push k f q) =     Turing.TM2.Stmt.push (Sum.inl k) (fun v => f v.1) (ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA M₁ M₂ q)

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (k : M₁.K) (f : M₁.σ → Option (M₁.Γ k) → M₁.σ) (q : Turing.TM2.Stmt M₁.Γ M₁.Λ M₁.σ),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA M₁ M₂ (Turing.TM2.Stmt.peek k f q) =     Turing.TM2.Stmt.peek (Sum.inl k) (fun v o => (f v.1 o, v.2)) (ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA M₁ M₂ q)

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA.eq_3
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (k : M₁.K) (f : M₁.σ → Option (M₁.Γ k) → M₁.σ) (q : Turing.TM2.Stmt M₁.Γ M₁.Λ M₁.σ),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA M₁ M₂ (Turing.TM2.Stmt.pop k f q) =     Turing.TM2.Stmt.pop (Sum.inl k) (fun v o => (f v.1 o, v.2)) (ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA M₁ M₂ q)

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA.eq_4
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (a : M₁.σ → M₁.σ) (q : Turing.TM2.Stmt M₁.Γ M₁.Λ M₁.σ),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA M₁ M₂ (Turing.TM2.Stmt.load a q) =     Turing.TM2.Stmt.load (fun v => (a v.1, v.2)) (ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA M₁ M₂ q)

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA.eq_5
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (f : M₁.σ → Bool) (q₁ q₂ : Turing.TM2.Stmt M₁.Γ M₁.Λ M₁.σ),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA M₁ M₂ (Turing.TM2.Stmt.branch f q₁ q₂) =     Turing.TM2.Stmt.branch (fun v => f v.1) (ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA M₁ M₂ q₁) (ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA M₁ M₂ q₂)

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA.eq_6
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (l : M₁.σ → M₁.Λ),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA M₁ M₂ (Turing.TM2.Stmt.goto l) = Turing.TM2.Stmt.goto fun v => Sum.inl (l v.1)

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA.eq_7
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA M₁ M₂ Turing.TM2.Stmt.halt = Turing.TM2.Stmt.goto fun x => ATK.ComposicaoTM2.t₁ M₁ M₂

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA.eq_def
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (x : Turing.TM2.Stmt M₁.Γ M₁.Λ M₁.σ),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA M₁ M₂ x =     match x with     | Turing.TM2.Stmt.push k f q => Turing.TM2.Stmt.push (Sum.inl k) (fun v => f v.1) (ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA M₁ M₂ q)     | Turing.TM2.Stmt.peek k f q =>       Turing.TM2.Stmt.peek (Sum.inl k) (fun v o => (f v.1 o, v.2)) (ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA M₁ M₂ q)     | Turing.TM2.Stmt.pop

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (k : M₂.K) (f : M₂.σ → M₂.Γ k) (q : Turing.TM2.Stmt M₂.Γ M₂.Λ M₂.σ),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB M₁ M₂ (Turing.TM2.Stmt.push k f q) =     Turing.TM2.Stmt.push (Sum.inr (Sum.inl k)) (fun v => f v.2.1) (ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB M₁ M₂ q)

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (k : M₂.K) (f : M₂.σ → Option (M₂.Γ k) → M₂.σ) (q : Turing.TM2.Stmt M₂.Γ M₂.Λ M₂.σ),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB M₁ M₂ (Turing.TM2.Stmt.peek k f q) =     Turing.TM2.Stmt.peek (Sum.inr (Sum.inl k)) (fun v o => (v.1, f v.2.1 o, v.2.2)) (ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB M₁ M₂ q)

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB.eq_3
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (k : M₂.K) (f : M₂.σ → Option (M₂.Γ k) → M₂.σ) (q : Turing.TM2.Stmt M₂.Γ M₂.Λ M₂.σ),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB M₁ M₂ (Turing.TM2.Stmt.pop k f q) =     Turing.TM2.Stmt.pop (Sum.inr (Sum.inl k)) (fun v o => (v.1, f v.2.1 o, v.2.2)) (ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB M₁ M₂ q)

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB.eq_4
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (a : M₂.σ → M₂.σ) (q : Turing.TM2.Stmt M₂.Γ M₂.Λ M₂.σ),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB M₁ M₂ (Turing.TM2.Stmt.load a q) =     Turing.TM2.Stmt.load (fun v => (v.1, a v.2.1, v.2.2)) (ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB M₁ M₂ q)

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB.eq_5
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (f : M₂.σ → Bool) (q₁ q₂ : Turing.TM2.Stmt M₂.Γ M₂.Λ M₂.σ),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB M₁ M₂ (Turing.TM2.Stmt.branch f q₁ q₂) =     Turing.TM2.Stmt.branch (fun v => f v.2.1) (ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB M₁ M₂ q₁) (ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB M₁ M₂ q₂)

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB.eq_6
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (l : M₂.σ → M₂.Λ),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB M₁ M₂ (Turing.TM2.Stmt.goto l) = Turing.TM2.Stmt.goto fun v => Sum.inr (Sum.inl (l v.2.1))

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB.eq_7
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2), ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB M₁ M₂ Turing.TM2.Stmt.halt = Turing.TM2.Stmt.halt

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB.eq_def
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (x : Turing.TM2.Stmt M₂.Γ M₂.Λ M₂.σ),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB M₁ M₂ x =     match x with     | Turing.TM2.Stmt.push k f q =>       Turing.TM2.Stmt.push (Sum.inr (Sum.inl k)) (fun v => f v.2.1) (ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB M₁ M₂ q)     | Turing.TM2.Stmt.peek k f q =>       Turing.TM2.Stmt.peek (Sum.inr (Sum.inl k)) (fun v o => (v.1, f v.2.1 o, v.2.2)) (ATK.ComposicaoTM2.lift

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.ne₁
theorems.statement: ∀ {M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2}, Sum.inl M₁.k₁ ≠ ATK.ComposicaoTM2.aux M₁ M₂

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.ne₂
theorems.statement: ∀ {M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2}, Sum.inl M₁.k₁ ≠ Sum.inr (Sum.inl M₂.k₀)

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.ne₃
theorems.statement: ∀ {M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2}, ATK.ComposicaoTM2.aux M₁ M₂ ≠ Sum.inr (Sum.inl M₂.k₀)

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.progc.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (e₁ : M₁.Γ M₁.k₁ → Bool) (e₂ : Bool → M₂.Γ M₂.k₀) (l : M₁.Λ),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.progc M₁ M₂ e₁ e₂ (Sum.inl l) = ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftA M₁ M₂ (M₁.m l)

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.progc.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (e₁ : M₁.Γ M₁.k₁ → Bool) (e₂ : Bool → M₂.Γ M₂.k₀) (l : M₂.Λ),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.progc M₁ M₂ e₁ e₂ (Sum.inr (Sum.inl l)) = ATK.ComposicaoTM2.liftB M₁ M₂ (M₂.m l)

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.progc.eq_3
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (e₁ : M₁.Γ M₁.k₁ → Bool) (e₂ : Bool → M₂.Γ M₂.k₀),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.progc M₁ M₂ e₁ e₂ (Sum.inr (Sum.inr false)) = ATK.ComposicaoTM2.transf₁ M₁ M₂ e₁

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.progc.eq_4
theorems.statement: ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Turing.FinTM2) (e₁ : M₁.Γ M₁.k₁ → Bool) (e₂ : Bool → M₂.Γ M₂.k₀),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.progc M₁ M₂ e₁ e₂ (Sum.inr (Sum.inr true)) = ATK.ComposicaoTM2.transf₂ M₁ M₂ e₂

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.pushes.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} {Γ : K → Type u_2} {Λ : Type u_3} {σ : Type u_4} (k : K) (a : σ → Γ k) (q : Turing.TM2.Stmt Γ Λ σ),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.pushes (Turing.TM2.Stmt.push k a q) = ATK.ComposicaoTM2.pushes q + 1

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.pushes.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} {Γ : K → Type u_2} {Λ : Type u_3} {σ : Type u_4} (k : K) (a : σ → Option (Γ k) → σ)   (q : Turing.TM2.Stmt Γ Λ σ), ATK.ComposicaoTM2.pushes (Turing.TM2.Stmt.peek k a q) = ATK.ComposicaoTM2.pushes q

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.pushes.eq_3
theorems.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} {Γ : K → Type u_2} {Λ : Type u_3} {σ : Type u_4} (k : K) (a : σ → Option (Γ k) → σ)   (q : Turing.TM2.Stmt Γ Λ σ), ATK.ComposicaoTM2.pushes (Turing.TM2.Stmt.pop k a q) = ATK.ComposicaoTM2.pushes q

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.pushes.eq_4
theorems.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} {Γ : K → Type u_2} {Λ : Type u_3} {σ : Type u_4} (a : σ → σ) (q : Turing.TM2.Stmt Γ Λ σ),   ATK.ComposicaoTM2.pushes (Turing.TM2.Stmt.load a q) = ATK.ComposicaoTM2.pushes q

theorems.name: ATK.ComposicaoTM2.pushes.eq_5

theorems.name: ATK.EMGeral.Cb.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ), ATK.EMGeral.Cb k = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |↑(bernoulli i)| * ↑(k.choose i)

theorems.name: ATK.EMGeral.Cb_nonneg
theorems.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ), 0 ≤ ATK.EMGeral.Cb k

theorems.name: ATK.EMGeral.EM.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (N M : ℕ) (s : ℂ),   ATK.EMGeral.EM N M s =     ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (↑n + 1) ^ (-s) + ↑N ^ (1 - s) / (s - 1) - ↑N ^ (-s) / 2 +       ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 2 (M + 1), ↑(bernoulli j) / ↑j.factorial * ATK.EMGeral.poch s (j - 1) * ↑N ^ (-s - ↑(j - 1))

theorems.name: ATK.EMGeral.abs_bernoulliFun_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) {x : ℝ}, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ 1 → |bernoulliFun k x| ≤ ATK.EMGeral.Cb k

theorems.name: ATK.EMGeral.abs_perB_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |ATK.EMGeral.perB k t| ≤ ATK.EMGeral.Cb k

theorems.name: ATK.EMGeral.bernoulliFun_eq_sum
theorems.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ), bernoulliFun k x = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ↑(bernoulli i) * ↑(k.choose i) * x ^ (k - i)

theorems.name: ATK.EMGeral.cauda_eq_J
theorems.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ}, 0 < s.re → ∀ {N : ℕ}, 1 ≤ N → ATK.BLEulerMaclaurin.cauda N s = ATK.EMGeral.J N 1 s + ↑N ^ (-s) / (2 * s)

theorems.name: ATK.EMGeral.integrableOn_J
theorems.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ} {k N : ℕ},   1 < s.re + ↑k →     1 ≤ N →       MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun t => ↑(ATK.EMGeral.perB k t) * ↑t ^ (-s - ↑k)) (Set.Ioi ↑N) MeasureTheory.volume

theorems.name: ATK.EMGeral.measurable_perB
theorems.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ), Measurable (ATK.EMGeral.perB k)

theorems.name: ATK.EMGeral.norm_J_le
theorems.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ} {k N : ℕ},   1 < s.re + ↑k → 1 ≤ N → ‖ATK.EMGeral.J N k s‖ ≤ ATK.EMGeral.Cb k * ↑N ^ (1 - s.re - ↑k) / (s.re + ↑k - 1)

theorems.name: ATK.EMGeral.norm_zeta_sub_EM_le
theorems.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ},   0 < s.re →     s ≠ 1 →       ∀ {N : ℕ},         1 ≤ N →           ∀ {M : ℕ},             1 ≤ M →               ‖riemannZeta s - ATK.EMGeral.EM N M s‖ ≤                 ‖ATK.EMGeral.poch s M‖ / ↑M.factorial * (ATK.EMGeral.Cb M * ↑N ^ (1 - s.re - ↑M) / (s.re + ↑M - 1))

theorems.name: ATK.EMGeral.perB.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ), ATK.EMGeral.perB k t = bernoulliFun k (Int.fract t)

theorems.name: ATK.EMGeral.perB_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ {k n : ℕ} {t : ℝ}, ↑n ≤ t → t < ↑n + 1 → ATK.EMGeral.perB k t = bernoulliFun k (t - ↑n)

theorems.name: ATK.EMGeral.poch.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (s : ℂ), ATK.EMGeral.poch s 0 = 1

theorems.name: ATK.EMGeral.poch.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (s : ℂ) (m : ℕ), ATK.EMGeral.poch s m.succ = ATK.EMGeral.poch s m * (s + ↑m)

theorems.name: ATK.EMGeral.poch.eq_def
theorems.statement: ∀ (s : ℂ) (x : ℕ),   ATK.EMGeral.poch s x =     match x with     | 0 => 1     | m.succ => ATK.EMGeral.poch s m * (s + ↑m)

theorems.name: ATK.EMGeral.recorrencia
theorems.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ},   0 < s.re →     ∀ {k : ℕ},       1 ≤ k →         ∀ {N : ℕ},           1 ≤ N →             ATK.EMGeral.J N k s =               -(↑(bernoulli (k + 1)) / (↑k + 1)) * ↑N ^ (-s - ↑k) + (s + ↑k) / (↑k + 1) * ATK.EMGeral.J N (k + 1) s

theorems.name: ATK.EMGeral.zeta_EM
theorems.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ},   0 < s.re →     s ≠ 1 →       ∀ {N : ℕ},         1 ≤ N →           ∀ {M : ℕ},             1 ≤ M → riemannZeta s = ATK.EMGeral.EM N M s - ATK.EMGeral.poch s M / ↑M.factorial * ATK.EMGeral.J N M s

theorems.name: ATK.Edrei.b_pos_ser

theorems.name: ATK.Edrei.cc_de_tn_ser

theorems.name: ATK.Edrei.coeff_bL
theorems.statement: ∀ (B : PowerSeries ℝ) (L : ℝ) (k : ℕ),   (PowerSeries.coeff k) ((1 - PowerSeries.C L * PowerSeries.X) * B) =     ATK.ASWRec.bL (fun k => (PowerSeries.coeff k) B) L k

theorems.name: ATK.Edrei.descida
theorems.statement: ∀ {a0 : ℝ},   0 < a0 →     ∀ {w : ℂ},       ¬(w.im = 0 ∧ w.re < 0) →         ∀ {c : ℕ → ℝ} {B : PowerSeries ℝ},           ATK.Edrei.Estado a0 w c B →             ∀ (k : ℕ),               ∃ c' B',                 ATK.Edrei.Estado a0 w c' B' ∧ (PowerSeries.coeff 1) B' + ↑k * (a0 * ‖w‖)⁻¹ ≤ (PowerSeries.coeff 1) B

theorems.name: ATK.Edrei.divLin.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (c : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℝ), ATK.Edrei.divLin c L 0 = c 0

theorems.name: ATK.Edrei.divLin.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (c : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (n : ℕ), ATK.Edrei.divLin c L n.succ = c (n + 1) - L * ATK.Edrei.divLin c L n

theorems.name: ATK.Edrei.divLin.eq_def
theorems.statement: ∀ (c : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (x : ℕ),   ATK.Edrei.divLin c L x =     match x with     | 0 => c 0     | n.succ => c (n + 1) - L * ATK.Edrei.divLin c L n

theorems.name: ATK.Edrei.divLin_partial
theorems.statement: ∀ (c : ℕ → ℝ) {L : ℝ},   L ≠ 0 → ∀ (n : ℕ), ATK.Edrei.divLin c L n * (-L⁻¹) ^ n = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * (-L⁻¹) ^ j

theorems.name: ATK.Edrei.edrei_inteira
theorems.statement: ∀ {a : ℕ → ℝ},   ATK.Edrei.Inteira a →     0 < a 0 → (ATK.ToeplitzTN.toep a).IsTotallyNonneg → ∀ {w : ℂ}, ATK.Edrei.ev a w = 0 → w.im = 0 ∧ w.re < 0

theorems.name: ATK.Edrei.ev.eq_1

theorems.name: ATK.Edrei.ev_divLin
theorems.statement: ∀ {c : ℕ → ℝ},   ATK.Edrei.Inteira c →     ∀ {L : ℝ},       ATK.Edrei.Inteira (ATK.Edrei.divLin c L) →         ∀ (z : ℂ), ATK.Edrei.ev c z = (1 + ↑L * z) * ATK.Edrei.ev (ATK.Edrei.divLin c L) z

theorems.name: ATK.Edrei.ev_mul_inv
theorems.statement: ∀ {a b : ℕ → ℝ},   ATK.Edrei.Inteira a →     ATK.Edrei.RecS a b →       ∀ {x : ℂ}, (Summable fun k => ‖↑(b k) * x ^ k‖) → ATK.Edrei.ev a (-x) * ∑' (k : ℕ), ↑(b k) * x ^ k = 1

theorems.name: ATK.Edrei.ev_ne_zero_at_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ {a : ℕ → ℝ}, 0 < a 0 → ∀ {w : ℂ}, ATK.Edrei.ev a w = 0 → w ≠ 0

theorems.name: ATK.Edrei.ev_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ), ATK.Edrei.ev a 0 = ↑(a 0)

theorems.name: ATK.Edrei.inteira_divLin
theorems.statement: ∀ {c : ℕ → ℝ},   ATK.Edrei.Inteira c → ∀ {L : ℝ}, 0 < L → ∑' (j : ℕ), c j * (-L⁻¹) ^ j = 0 → ATK.Edrei.Inteira (ATK.Edrei.divLin c L)

theorems.name: ATK.Edrei.passo
theorems.statement: ∀ {a0 : ℝ},   0 < a0 →     ∀ {w : ℂ},       ¬(w.im = 0 ∧ w.re < 0) →         ∀ {c : ℕ → ℝ} {B : PowerSeries ℝ},           ATK.Edrei.Estado a0 w c B →             ∃ c' B', ATK.Edrei.Estado a0 w c' B' ∧ (PowerSeries.coeff 1) B' + (a0 * ‖w‖)⁻¹ ≤ (PowerSeries.coeff 1) B

theorems.name: ATK.Edrei.prodCoef.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (a0 : ℝ) (α : ℕ → ℝ), ATK.Edrei.prodCoef a0 α 0 = fun n => if n = 0 then a0 else 0

theorems.name: ATK.Edrei.prodCoef.eq_2

theorems.name: ATK.EtaCriterio.eta_sub_Peta

theorems.name: ATK.EtaCriterio.norm_eta_sub_Peta

theorems.name: ATK.NSPicard.Gv.eq_1

theorems.name: ATK.PerronSuave.mellin_kk_sub

theorems.name: ATK.PerronSuave.norm_AN_sub_le

theorems.statement: ∀ (z : ℂ), ‖ATK.PerronSuave.KK z‖ = 1 / (‖z‖ * ‖z + 1‖)

theorems.name: ATK.PerronSuave.norm_KK_le
theorems.statement: ∀ {σ m : ℝ},   0 < m →     m ≤ 1 → m ≤ |σ| → 1 / 2 ≤ |σ + 1| → ∀ (y : ℝ), ‖ATK.PerronSuave.KK (↑σ + ↑y * Complex.I)‖ ≤ 2 / m / (1 + y ^ 2)

theorems.statement: ∀ {N : ℕ},   0 < N →     ∀ {w : ℂ} {ε CF η : ℝ},       (∀ (s : ℂ), 1 / 2 + ε / 2 ≤ s.re → ‖ATK.RHLogZeta.F s‖ ≤ CF * (1 + |s.im|) ^ η) →         0 ≤ η →           0 ≤ CF →             ∀ {z : ℂ},               1 / 2 + ε / 2 ≤ (w + z).re →                 ‖ATK.PerronSuave.phi N w z‖ ≤ ↑N ^ z.re * (CF * (1 + |w.im|) ^ η * (1 + |z.im|) ^ η)

theorems.name: ATK.PolyLista.escala.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (c : ℤ), ATK.PolyLista.escala c [] = []

theorems.name: ATK.PolyLista.escala.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (c a : ℤ) (l : List ℤ), ATK.PolyLista.escala c (a :: l) = c * a :: ATK.PolyLista.escala c l

theorems.name: ATK.PolyLista.escala.eq_def
theorems.statement: ∀ (c : ℤ) (x : List ℤ),   ATK.PolyLista.escala c x =     match x with     | [] => []     | a :: l => c * a :: ATK.PolyLista.escala c l

theorems.name: ATK.PolyLista.igual_de_listas
theorems.statement: ∀ {l m : List ℤ} (k j : ℕ),   l ++ List.replicate k 0 = m ++ List.replicate j 0 → ATK.PolyLista.poly l = ATK.PolyLista.poly m

theorems.name: ATK.PolyLista.poly.eq_1
theorems.statement: ATK.PolyLista.poly [] = 0

theorems.name: ATK.PolyLista.poly.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (a : ℤ) (l : List ℤ), ATK.PolyLista.poly (a :: l) = Polynomial.C a + Polynomial.X * ATK.PolyLista.poly l

theorems.name: ATK.PolyLista.poly.eq_def
theorems.statement: ∀ (x : List ℤ),   ATK.PolyLista.poly x =     match x with     | [] => 0     | a :: l => Polynomial.C a + Polynomial.X * ATK.PolyLista.poly l

theorems.name: ATK.PolyLista.poly_ceros
theorems.statement: ∀ (l : List ℤ) (k : ℕ), ATK.PolyLista.poly (l ++ List.replicate k 0) = ATK.PolyLista.poly l

theorems.name: ATK.PolyLista.poly_cons
theorems.statement: ∀ (a : ℤ) (l : List ℤ), ATK.PolyLista.poly (a :: l) = Polynomial.C a + Polynomial.X * ATK.PolyLista.poly l

theorems.name: ATK.PolyLista.poly_const
theorems.statement: ∀ (c : ℤ), ATK.PolyLista.poly [c] = Polynomial.C c

theorems.name: ATK.PolyLista.poly_escala
theorems.statement: ∀ (c : ℤ) (l : List ℤ), ATK.PolyLista.poly (ATK.PolyLista.escala c l) = Polynomial.C c * ATK.PolyLista.poly l

theorems.name: ATK.PolyLista.poly_nil
theorems.statement: ATK.PolyLista.poly [] = 0

theorems.name: ATK.PolyLista.poly_produto
theorems.statement: ∀ (l m : List ℤ), ATK.PolyLista.poly (ATK.PolyLista.produto l m) = ATK.PolyLista.poly l * ATK.PolyLista.poly m

theorems.name: ATK.PolyLista.poly_replicate
theorems.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ), ATK.PolyLista.poly (List.replicate k 0) = 0

theorems.name: ATK.PolyLista.poly_soma
theorems.statement: ∀ (l m : List ℤ), ATK.PolyLista.poly (ATK.PolyLista.soma l m) = ATK.PolyLista.poly l + ATK.PolyLista.poly m

theorems.name: ATK.PolyLista.produto.eq_1

theorems.name: ATK.PolyLista.produto.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (x : List ℤ) (a : ℤ) (l : List ℤ),   ATK.PolyLista.produto (a :: l) x = ATK.PolyLista.soma (ATK.PolyLista.escala a x) (0 :: ATK.PolyLista.produto l x)

theorems.name: ATK.PolyLista.produto.eq_def
theorems.statement: ∀ (x x_1 : List ℤ),   ATK.PolyLista.produto x x_1 =     match x, x_1 with     | [], x => []     | a :: l, m => ATK.PolyLista.soma (ATK.PolyLista.escala a m) (0 :: ATK.PolyLista.produto l m)

theorems.name: ATK.PolyLista.soma.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (x : List ℤ), ATK.PolyLista.soma [] x = x

theorems.name: ATK.PolyLista.soma.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (a : ℤ) (l : List ℤ), ATK.PolyLista.soma (a :: l) [] = a :: l

theorems.name: ATK.PolyLista.soma.eq_3
theorems.statement: ∀ (a : ℤ) (l : List ℤ) (b : ℤ) (m : List ℤ), ATK.PolyLista.soma (a :: l) (b :: m) = (a + b) :: ATK.PolyLista.soma l m

theorems.name: ATK.PolyLista.soma.eq_def
theorems.statement: ∀ (x x_1 : List ℤ),   ATK.PolyLista.soma x x_1 =     match x, x_1 with     | [], m => m     | a :: l, [] => a :: l     | a :: l, b :: m => (a + b) :: ATK.PolyLista.soma l m

theorems.name: ATK.PolyaCalor.aux_prod

theorems.name: ATK.PolyaCalor.calorExato.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (l : ℝ) (p : Polynomial ℝ),   ATK.PolyaCalor.calorExato l p =     ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), ((-l) ^ m / ↑m.factorial) • (⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[2 * m] p

theorems.name: ATK.PolyaCalor.calorExato_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ (p : Polynomial ℝ), ATK.PolyaCalor.calorExato 0 p = p

theorems.name: ATK.PolyaCalor.coeff_iter

theorems.name: ATK.PolyaCalor.coeff_natDegree_passoCalor
theorems.statement: ∀ (l : ℝ) (f : Polynomial ℝ), (ATK.Laguerre.passoCalor l f).coeff f.natDegree = f.coeff f.natDegree

theorems.name: ATK.PolyaCalor.iter_passoCalor
theorems.statement: ∀ (l : ℝ) (p : Polynomial ℝ) (N : ℕ),   (ATK.Laguerre.passoCalor l)^[N] p =     ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (↑(N.choose m) * (-l) ^ m) • (⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[2 * m] p

theorems.name: ATK.PolyaCalor.natDegree_iter
theorems.statement: ∀ (l : ℝ) (p : Polynomial ℝ) (N : ℕ), ((ATK.Laguerre.passoCalor l)^[N] p).natDegree = p.natDegree

theorems.name: ATK.PolyaCalor.natDegree_passoCalor
theorems.statement: ∀ (l : ℝ) (f : Polynomial ℝ), (ATK.Laguerre.passoCalor l f).natDegree = f.natDegree

theorems.name: ATK.PolyaCalor.norm_eval_ge
theorems.statement: ∀ {p : Polynomial ℝ},   ATK.Laguerre.RealRooted p →     ∀ (z : ℂ), |p.leadingCoeff| * |z.im| ^ p.natDegree ≤ ‖Polynomial.eval z (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) p)‖

theorems.name: ATK.PolyaCalor.realRooted_calorExato
theorems.statement: ∀ {p : Polynomial ℝ},   ATK.Laguerre.RealRooted p → ∀ {l : ℝ}, 0 ≤ l → ATK.Laguerre.RealRooted (ATK.PolyaCalor.calorExato l p)

theorems.name: ATK.PolyaCalor.realRooted_of_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ {f : ℕ → Polynomial ℝ} {g : Polynomial ℝ} {n : ℕ},   (∀ (N : ℕ), ATK.Laguerre.RealRooted (f N)) →     (∀ (N : ℕ), (f N).natDegree = n) →       (∀ (k : ℕ), Filter.Tendsto (fun N => (f N).coeff k) Filter.atTop (nhds (g.coeff k))) →         g.coeff n ≠ 0 → ATK.Laguerre.RealRooted g

theorems.name: ATK.PolyaCalor.tendsto_choose_div_pow
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ), Filter.Tendsto (fun N => ↑(N.choose m) / ↑N ^ m) Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / ↑m.factorial))

theorems.name: ATK.PolyaCalor.tendsto_iter_calor
theorems.statement: ∀ (l : ℝ) (p : Polynomial ℝ) (k : ℕ),   Filter.Tendsto (fun N => ((ATK.Laguerre.passoCalor (l / ↑N))^[N] p).coeff k) Filter.atTop     (nhds ((ATK.PolyaCalor.calorExato l p).coeff k))

theorems.name: ATK.PonteCoefCurva32.bsd_posto_curva32_P1

theorems.name: ATK.PonteCoefCurva32.cota_inteira
theorems.statement: ATK.PonteCoefCurva32.FatoresPadrao → ∀ (n : ℕ), |ATK.CongruentCurve.E.LFunction n| ≤ ↑n

theorems.name: ATK.PonteCoefCurva32.cota_local

theorems.name: ATK.PonteCoefCurva32.cota_pot
theorems.statement: ATK.PonteCoefCurva32.FatoresPadrao →   ∀ {p : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → ∀ {k : ℕ}, 1 ≤ k → |ATK.CongruentCurve.E.LFunction (p ^ k)| ≤ ↑p ^ k

theorems.name: ATK.PonteCoefCurva32.hecke.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (a p : ℤ), ATK.PonteCoefCurva32.hecke a p 0 = 1

theorems.name: ATK.PonteCoefCurva32.hecke.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (a p : ℤ), ATK.PonteCoefCurva32.hecke a p 1 = a

theorems.name: ATK.PonteCoefCurva32.hecke.eq_3
theorems.statement: ∀ (a p : ℤ) (k : ℕ),   ATK.PonteCoefCurva32.hecke a p k.succ.succ =     a * ATK.PonteCoefCurva32.hecke a p (k + 1) - p * ATK.PonteCoefCurva32.hecke a p k

theorems.name: ATK.PonteCoefCurva32.hecke.eq_def

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.acc.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (S : List Bool) (x : Option Bool) (v : Bool) (G : List Bool),   ATK.SATemNP.acc S x ATK.SATemNP.Md.p0 (false :: v :: G) = ATK.SATemNP.acc S x (ATK.SATemNP.Md.p1 v none S.reverse) G

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.acc.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (S : List Bool) (x : Option Bool) (G : List Bool),   ATK.SATemNP.acc S x ATK.SATemNP.Md.p0 (true :: true :: G) =     (decide (x = some true) && ATK.SATemNP.acc S none ATK.SATemNP.Md.p0 G)

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.acc.eq_3
theorems.statement: ∀ (S : List Bool) (x : Option Bool), ATK.SATemNP.acc S x ATK.SATemNP.Md.p0 [] = decide (x = none)

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.acc.eq_4
theorems.statement: ∀ (S : List Bool) (x : Option Bool) (x_1 : List Bool),   (∀ (v : Bool) (G : List Bool), x_1 = false :: v :: G → False) →     (∀ (G : List Bool), x_1 = true :: true :: G → False) →       (x_1 = [] → False) → ATK.SATemNP.acc S x ATK.SATemNP.Md.p0 x_1 = false

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.acc.eq_5
theorems.statement: ∀ (S : List Bool) (x : Option Bool) (v : Bool) (lb : Option Bool) (W : List Bool) (b : Bool) (G : List Bool),   ATK.SATemNP.acc S x (ATK.SATemNP.Md.p1 v lb W) (false :: b :: G) =     ATK.SATemNP.acc S x (ATK.SATemNP.Md.p1 v (some b) (ATK.SATemNP.filt b W)) G

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.acc.eq_6
theorems.statement: ∀ (S : List Bool) (x : Option Bool) (v : Bool) (lb : Option Bool) (W G : List Bool),   ATK.SATemNP.acc S x (ATK.SATemNP.Md.p1 v lb W) (true :: false :: G) =     (!decide (lb = some false) &&       ATK.SATemNP.acc S (some (x.getD false || decide ((ATK.SATemNP.lk ATK.SATemNP.ML.l0 W).1 = some v)))         ATK.SATemNP.Md.p0 G)

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.acc.eq_7
theorems.statement: ∀ (S : List Bool) (x : Option Bool) (x_1 : List Bool) (v : Bool) (lb : Option Bool) (W : List Bool),   (∀ (b : Bool) (G : List Bool), x_1 = false :: b :: G → False) →     (∀ (G : List Bool), x_1 = true :: false :: G → False) → ATK.SATemNP.acc S x (ATK.SATemNP.Md.p1 v lb W) x_1 = false

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.acc.eq_def

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.acc_cla

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.acc_cnf

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.acc_lit

theorems.statement: ∀ (e : ATK.SATemNP.Entrada),   ATK.SATemNP.codEntrada e = [false, e.2] ++ List.flatMap ATK.ModeloPNP.simb e.1 ++ [true, false]

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.codEntradas.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (E : List ATK.SATemNP.Entrada), ATK.SATemNP.codEntradas E = List.flatMap ATK.SATemNP.codEntrada E

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.codEntradas_len
theorems.statement: ∀ (τ : ℕ → Bool) (C : ATK.ModeloPNP.Clausula),   (ATK.SATemNP.codEntradas (List.map (fun ℓ => (ℓ.1.bits, τ ℓ.1)) C)).length =     (List.flatMap ATK.ModeloPNP.codLiteral C).length

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.cookLevin_iff
theorems.statement: ATK.Conditional.PvsNP.CookLevin ATK.ModeloPNP.modeloPNP ATK.ModeloPNP.SAT ↔   ∀ L ∈ ATK.LigacaoPNP.classeNP, ATK.ModeloPNP.Red L ATK.ModeloPNP.SAT

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.deBits.eq_1
theorems.statement: ATK.SATemNP.deBits [] = 0

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.deBits.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (l : List Bool), ATK.SATemNP.deBits (b :: l) = Nat.bit b (ATK.SATemNP.deBits l)

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.deBits.eq_def
theorems.statement: ∀ (x : List Bool),   ATK.SATemNP.deBits x =     match x with     | [] => 0     | b :: l => Nat.bit b (ATK.SATemNP.deBits l)

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.deBits_bits
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), ATK.SATemNP.deBits n.bits = n

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.deBits_ne_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ {l : List Bool}, l ≠ [] → ATK.SATemNP.Canonica l → ATK.SATemNP.deBits l ≠ 0

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.dec_some
theorems.statement: ∀ (a : Bool), decide (some a = some true) = a

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.falha.eq_1
theorems.statement: ATK.SATemNP.falha =   ATK.SATemNP.irS (fun st => { v := st.v, b := st.b, ok := false, fl := st.fl, lb := st.lb }) ATK.SATemNP.Lb.Zs

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.falha_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (st : ATK.SATemNP.St) (S G W T : List Bool) (a b : Option Bool),   Turing.TM2.stepAux ATK.SATemNP.falha (a, b, st) (ATK.SATemNP.stks S G W T) =     ATK.SATemNP.cf ATK.SATemNP.Lb.Zs { v := st.v, b := st.b, ok := false, fl := st.fl, lb := st.lb } S G W T

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.filt.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (W : List Bool),   ATK.SATemNP.filt b W =     (ATK.SATemNP.ftr b ATK.SATemNP.MF.e0 W []).2.reverse ++ (ATK.SATemNP.ftr b ATK.SATemNP.MF.e0 W []).1

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.filtE.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (E : List ATK.SATemNP.Entrada),   ATK.SATemNP.filtE b E =     List.filterMap       (fun e =>         match e.1 with         | c :: r => if c = b then some (r, e.2) else none         | [] => none)       E

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.filt_cod
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (E : List ATK.SATemNP.Entrada),   ATK.SATemNP.filt b (ATK.SATemNP.codEntradas E) = ATK.SATemNP.codEntradas (ATK.SATemNP.filtE b E)

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.filt_len
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (W : List Bool), (ATK.SATemNP.filt b W).length ≤ W.length

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.filts.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (bs W : List Bool), ATK.SATemNP.filts bs W = List.foldl (fun W b => ATK.SATemNP.filt b W) W bs

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.filtsE.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (bs : List Bool) (E : List ATK.SATemNP.Entrada),   ATK.SATemNP.filtsE bs E = List.foldl (fun E b => ATK.SATemNP.filtE b E) E bs

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.filts_cod
theorems.statement: ∀ (bs : List Bool) (E : List ATK.SATemNP.Entrada),   ATK.SATemNP.filts bs (ATK.SATemNP.codEntradas E) = ATK.SATemNP.codEntradas (ATK.SATemNP.filtsE bs E)

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.foldl_passo
theorems.statement: ∀ (S : List Bool) (C : ATK.ModeloPNP.Clausula) (fl : Option Bool),   List.foldl (ATK.SATemNP.passoFl S) fl C =     if C = [] then fl else some (fl.getD false || List.any C (ATK.SATemNP.bom S))

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.forma
theorems.statement: ∀ (S : List Bool) (n : ℕ) (G : List Bool),   G.length ≤ n →     (∀ (fl : Option Bool),         ATK.SATemNP.acc S fl ATK.SATemNP.Md.p0 G = true →           (fl = none → ∃ φ, ATK.ModeloPNP.codCNF φ = G) ∧             (fl ≠ none → ∃ C φ, ATK.ModeloPNP.codClausula C ++ ATK.ModeloPNP.codCNF φ = G)) ∧       ∀ (fl : Option Bool) (v : Bool) (pre W : List Bool),         ATK.SATemNP.acc S fl (ATK.SATemNP.Md

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.ftr.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (x : List Bool) (x_3 : Bool) (W : List Bool),   ATK.SATemNP.ftr b ATK.SATemNP.MF.e0 (false :: x_3 :: W) x = ATK.SATemNP.ftr b (ATK.SATemNP.MF.e1 x_3) W x

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.ftr.eq_10
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (x : List Bool) (head head_1 : Bool) (W : List Bool),   (head = false → False) →     (head = true → head_1 = false → False) → ATK.SATemNP.ftr b ATK.SATemNP.MF.ec (head :: head_1 :: W) x = (W, x)

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.ftr.eq_11
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (x x_1 : List Bool),   (∀ (y : Bool) (W : List Bool), x = false :: y :: W → False) →     (∀ (W : List Bool), x = true :: false :: W → False) →       (∀ (head head_1 : Bool) (W : List Bool), x = head :: head_1 :: W → False) →         ATK.SATemNP.ftr b ATK.SATemNP.MF.ec x x_1 = ([], x_1)

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.ftr.eq_12
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (x : List Bool) (head : Bool) (W : List Bool),   ATK.SATemNP.ftr b ATK.SATemNP.MF.es (false :: head :: W) x = ATK.SATemNP.ftr b ATK.SATemNP.MF.es W x

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.ftr.eq_13
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (x W : List Bool),   ATK.SATemNP.ftr b ATK.SATemNP.MF.es (true :: false :: W) x = ATK.SATemNP.ftr b ATK.SATemNP.MF.e0 W x

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.ftr.eq_14
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (x : List Bool) (head head_1 : Bool) (W : List Bool),   (head = false → False) →     (head = true → head_1 = false → False) → ATK.SATemNP.ftr b ATK.SATemNP.MF.es (head :: head_1 :: W) x = (W, x)

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.ftr.eq_15
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (x x_1 : List Bool),   (∀ (head : Bool) (W : List Bool), x = false :: head :: W → False) →     (∀ (W : List Bool), x = true :: false :: W → False) →       (∀ (head head_1 : Bool) (W : List Bool), x = head :: head_1 :: W → False) →         ATK.SATemNP.ftr b ATK.SATemNP.MF.es x x_1 = ([], x_1)

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.ftr.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (x : List Bool) (head head_1 : Bool) (W : List Bool),   (head = false → False) → ATK.SATemNP.ftr b ATK.SATemNP.MF.e0 (head :: head_1 :: W) x = (W, x)

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.ftr.eq_3
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (x x_1 : List Bool),   (∀ (x_2 : Bool) (W : List Bool), x = false :: x_2 :: W → False) →     (∀ (head head_1 : Bool) (W : List Bool), x = head :: head_1 :: W → False) →       ATK.SATemNP.ftr b ATK.SATemNP.MF.e0 x x_1 = ([], x_1)

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.ftr.eq_4
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (x : List Bool) (x_3 y : Bool) (W : List Bool),   ATK.SATemNP.ftr b (ATK.SATemNP.MF.e1 x_3) (false :: y :: W) x =     if y = b then ATK.SATemNP.ftr b ATK.SATemNP.MF.ec W (x_3 :: false :: x) else ATK.SATemNP.ftr b ATK.SATemNP.MF.es W x

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.ftr.eq_5
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (x : List Bool) (x_3 : Bool) (W : List Bool),   ATK.SATemNP.ftr b (ATK.SATemNP.MF.e1 x_3) (true :: false :: W) x = ATK.SATemNP.ftr b ATK.SATemNP.MF.e0 W x

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.ftr.eq_6
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (x : List Bool) (x_3 head head_1 : Bool) (W : List Bool),   (head = false → False) →     (head = true → head_1 = false → False) → ATK.SATemNP.ftr b (ATK.SATemNP.MF.e1 x_3) (head :: head_1 :: W) x = (W, x)

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.ftr.eq_9
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (x W : List Bool),   ATK.SATemNP.ftr b ATK.SATemNP.MF.ec (true :: false :: W) x =     ATK.SATemNP.ftr b ATK.SATemNP.MF.e0 W (false :: true :: x)

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.ftr.eq_def
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (x : ATK.SATemNP.MF) (x_1 x_2 : List Bool),   ATK.SATemNP.ftr b x x_1 x_2 =     match x, x_1, x_2 with     | ATK.SATemNP.MF.e0, false :: x :: W, T => ATK.SATemNP.ftr b (ATK.SATemNP.MF.e1 x) W T     | ATK.SATemNP.MF.e0, head :: head_1 :: W, T => (W, T)     | ATK.SATemNP.MF.e0, x, T => ([], T)     | ATK.SATemNP.MF.e1 x, false :: y :: W, T =>       if y = b then ATK.SATemNP.ftr b ATK.SAT

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.ftr_len
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (m : ATK.SATemNP.MF) (W T : List Bool),   (ATK.SATemNP.ftr b m W T).1.length + (ATK.SATemNP.ftr b m W T).2.length ≤ W.length + T.length

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.getLast?_cons_or
theorems.statement: ∀ (c : Bool) (bs : List Bool), (c :: bs).getLast? = bs.getLast?.or (some c)

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.haltList_sat
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool), Turing.haltList ATK.SATemNP.satTM [b] = ATK.SATemNP.cfFim b

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.initList_sat
theorems.statement: ∀ (x : List Bool), Turing.initList ATK.SATemNP.satTM x = ATK.SATemNP.cf ATK.SATemNP.Lb.U ATK.SATemNP.st0 x [] [] []

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.ir.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (l : ATK.SATemNP.Lb),   ATK.SATemNP.ir l = Turing.TM2.Stmt.load (fun σ => (none, none, σ.2.2)) (Turing.TM2.Stmt.goto fun x => l)

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.irS.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (f : ATK.SATemNP.St → ATK.SATemNP.St) (l : ATK.SATemNP.Lb),   ATK.SATemNP.irS f l = Turing.TM2.Stmt.load (fun σ => (none, none, f σ.2.2)) (Turing.TM2.Stmt.goto fun x => l)

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.lb_canon
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), n.bits.getLast?.or none ≠ some false

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.len_cert
theorems.statement: ∀ (τ : ℕ → Bool) (φ : ATK.ModeloPNP.CNF),   (ATK.SATemNP.codEntradas (List.flatMap (fun C => List.map (fun ℓ => (ℓ.1.bits, τ ℓ.1)) C) φ)).length ≤     (ATK.ModeloPNP.codCNF φ).length

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.lk.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (x_2 : Bool) (W : List Bool),   ATK.SATemNP.lk ATK.SATemNP.ML.l0 (false :: x_2 :: W) = ATK.SATemNP.lk (ATK.SATemNP.ML.l1 x_2) W

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.lk.eq_10
theorems.statement: ∀ (head head_1 : Bool) (W : List Bool),   (head = false → False) →     (head = true → head_1 = false → False) → ATK.SATemNP.lk ATK.SATemNP.ML.ls (head :: head_1 :: W) = (none, W)

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.lk.eq_11
theorems.statement: ∀ (x : List Bool),   (∀ (head : Bool) (W : List Bool), x = false :: head :: W → False) →     (∀ (W : List Bool), x = true :: false :: W → False) →       (∀ (head head_1 : Bool) (W : List Bool), x = head :: head_1 :: W → False) →         ATK.SATemNP.lk ATK.SATemNP.ML.ls x = (none, [])

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.lk.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (head head_1 : Bool) (W : List Bool),   (head = false → False) → ATK.SATemNP.lk ATK.SATemNP.ML.l0 (head :: head_1 :: W) = (none, W)

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.lk.eq_3
theorems.statement: ∀ (x : List Bool),   (∀ (x_1 : Bool) (W : List Bool), x = false :: x_1 :: W → False) →     (∀ (head head_1 : Bool) (W : List Bool), x = head :: head_1 :: W → False) →       ATK.SATemNP.lk ATK.SATemNP.ML.l0 x = (none, [])

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.lk.eq_4
theorems.statement: ∀ (x_2 : Bool) (W : List Bool), ATK.SATemNP.lk (ATK.SATemNP.ML.l1 x_2) (true :: false :: W) = (some x_2, W)

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.lk.eq_5
theorems.statement: ∀ (x_2 head : Bool) (W : List Bool),   ATK.SATemNP.lk (ATK.SATemNP.ML.l1 x_2) (false :: head :: W) = ATK.SATemNP.lk ATK.SATemNP.ML.ls W

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.lk.eq_6
theorems.statement: ∀ (x_2 head head_1 : Bool) (W : List Bool),   (head = true → head_1 = false → False) →     (head = false → False) → ATK.SATemNP.lk (ATK.SATemNP.ML.l1 x_2) (head :: head_1 :: W) = (none, W)

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.lk.eq_7
theorems.statement: ∀ (x : List Bool) (x_2 : Bool),   (∀ (W : List Bool), x = true :: false :: W → False) →     (∀ (head : Bool) (W : List Bool), x = false :: head :: W → False) →       (∀ (head head_1 : Bool) (W : List Bool), x = head :: head_1 :: W → False) →         ATK.SATemNP.lk (ATK.SATemNP.ML.l1 x_2) x = (none, [])

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.lk.eq_8
theorems.statement: ∀ (head : Bool) (W : List Bool),   ATK.SATemNP.lk ATK.SATemNP.ML.ls (false :: head :: W) = ATK.SATemNP.lk ATK.SATemNP.ML.ls W

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.lk.eq_9
theorems.statement: ∀ (W : List Bool), ATK.SATemNP.lk ATK.SATemNP.ML.ls (true :: false :: W) = ATK.SATemNP.lk ATK.SATemNP.ML.l0 W

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.lk.eq_def
theorems.statement: ∀ (x : ATK.SATemNP.ML) (x_1 : List Bool),   ATK.SATemNP.lk x x_1 =     match x, x_1 with     | ATK.SATemNP.ML.l0, false :: x :: W => ATK.SATemNP.lk (ATK.SATemNP.ML.l1 x) W     | ATK.SATemNP.ML.l0, head :: head_1 :: W => (none, W)     | ATK.SATemNP.ML.l0, x => (none, [])     | ATK.SATemNP.ML.l1 x, true :: false :: W => (some x, W)     | ATK.SATemNP.ML.l1 x, false :: head :: W => ATK.SATemNP.lk ATK.

theorems.statement: ∀ (E : List ATK.SATemNP.Entrada),   (ATK.SATemNP.lk ATK.SATemNP.ML.l0 (ATK.SATemNP.codEntradas E)).1 = ATK.SATemNP.lookupE E

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.lk_len
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ATK.SATemNP.ML) (W : List Bool), (ATK.SATemNP.lk m W).2.length ≤ W.length

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.lk_ls
theorems.statement: ∀ (bs W : List Bool),   ATK.SATemNP.lk ATK.SATemNP.ML.ls (List.flatMap ATK.ModeloPNP.simb bs ++ [true, false] ++ W) =     ATK.SATemNP.lk ATK.SATemNP.ML.l0 W

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.lookupE.eq_1
theorems.statement: ATK.SATemNP.lookupE [] = none

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.lookupE.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (e : ATK.SATemNP.Entrada) (E : List ATK.SATemNP.Entrada),   ATK.SATemNP.lookupE (e :: E) = if e.1 = [] then some e.2 else ATK.SATemNP.lookupE E

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.lookupE.eq_def
theorems.statement: ∀ (x : List ATK.SATemNP.Entrada),   ATK.SATemNP.lookupE x =     match x with     | [] => none     | e :: E => if e.1 = [] then some e.2 else ATK.SATemNP.lookupE E

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.lookupE_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ {v : Bool} {E : List ATK.SATemNP.Entrada},   (∃ e ∈ E, e.1 = []) → (∀ e ∈ E, e.1 = [] → e.2 = v) → ATK.SATemNP.lookupE E = some v

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.mem_filtE
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (E : List ATK.SATemNP.Entrada) (e : ATK.SATemNP.Entrada), e ∈ ATK.SATemNP.filtE b E ↔ (b :: e.1, e.2) ∈ E

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.mem_filtsE
theorems.statement: ∀ (bs : List Bool) (E : List ATK.SATemNP.Entrada) (e : ATK.SATemNP.Entrada),   e ∈ ATK.SATemNP.filtsE bs E ↔ (bs ++ e.1, e.2) ∈ E

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.nf.eq_1
theorems.statement: ATK.SATemNP.nf =   ATK.SATemNP.irS (fun st => { v := st.v, b := st.b, ok := st.ok, fl := some (st.fl.getD false), lb := st.lb })     ATK.SATemNP.Lb.X

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.nf_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (st : ATK.SATemNP.St) (S G T w : List Bool) (a b : Option Bool),   Turing.TM2.stepAux ATK.SATemNP.nf (a, b, st) (ATK.SATemNP.stks S G w T) =     ATK.SATemNP.cf ATK.SATemNP.Lb.X (ATK.SATemNP.stL st none) S G w T

theorems.name: ATK.SATemNP.passoFl.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (S : List Bool) (fl : Option Bool) (ℓ : ATK.ModeloPNP.Literal),   ATK.SATemNP.passoFl S fl ℓ = some (fl.getD false || ATK.SATemNP.bom S ℓ)

theorems.statement: ATK.SATemNP.prog ATK.SATemNP.Lb.U =   Turing.TM2.Stmt.pop ATK.SATemNP.Pk.s (fun σ o => (o, σ.2))     (Turing.TM2.Stmt.pop ATK.SATemNP.Pk.s (fun σ o => (σ.1, o, σ.2.2))       (Turing.TM2.Stmt.branch (fun σ => σ.1.isSome && decide (σ.1 = σ.2.1))         (Turing.TM2.Stmt.push ATK.SATemNP.Pk.t (fun σ => σ.1.getD false) (ATK.SATemNP.ir ATK.SATemNP.Lb.U))         (ATK.SATemNP.ir ATK.SATemNP.Lb.R)))

theorems.name: ATK.Termos.Beal.refutacao_iff
theorems.statement: ATK.Termos.Beal.refutacao ↔   ∃ a b c x y z,     0 < a ∧       0 < b ∧ 0 < c ∧ 2 < x ∧ 2 < y ∧ 2 < z ∧ a ^ x + b ^ y = c ^ z ∧ ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p ∣ a → p ∣ b → ¬p ∣ c

theorems.name: ATK.Termos.Beal.refutacao_iff_mdc
theorems.statement: ATK.Termos.Beal.refutacao ↔   ∃ a b c x y z, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 0 < c ∧ 2 < x ∧ 2 < y ∧ 2 < z ∧ a ^ x + b ^ y = c ^ z ∧ a.gcd (b.gcd c) = 1

theorems.name: ATK.Termos.Beal.refutacao_iff_residual
theorems.statement: ATK.Termos.Beal.refutacao ↔   ∃ a b c x y z,     0 < a ∧       0 < b ∧         0 < c ∧           2 < x ∧             2 < y ∧               2 < z ∧                 ¬3 ∣ x.gcd (y.gcd z) ∧                   ¬4 ∣ x.gcd (y.gcd z) ∧                     ¬(4 ∣ x ∧ 4 ∣ y ∧ 2 ∣ z) ∧                       ¬(4 ∣ x ∧ 2 ∣ y ∧ 4 ∣ z) ∧ ¬(2 ∣ x ∧ 4 ∣ y ∧ 4 ∣ z) ∧ a.Coprime b ∧ a ^ x + b ^ y = c ^ z

theorems.name: ATK.Termos.NS.fecha_oficial
theorems.statement: ATK.Termos.NS.ponteB3 ATK.LigacaoNS.modeloNS →   ATK.Termos.NS.produtorO3 ATK.LigacaoNS.modeloNS →     ∀ (ν : ℝ),       0 < ν →         ∀ (u₀ : SchwartzMap ATK.LigacaoNS.E3 ATK.LigacaoNS.E3),           (∀ (x : ATK.LigacaoNS.E3), ATK.LigacaoNS.div (⇑u₀) x = 0) → ∃ U P, ATK.LigacaoNS.SolucaoGlobal ν (⇑u₀) U P

theorems.statement: ATK.Termos.NS.refutacao ATK.LigacaoNS.modeloNS ↔   ∃ ν,     0 < ν ∧       ∃ u₀, (∀ (x : ATK.LigacaoNS.E3), ATK.LigacaoNS.div (⇑u₀) x = 0) ∧ ¬∃ U P, ATK.LigacaoNS.SolucaoGlobal ν (⇑u₀) U P

theorems.statement: ∀ {M : ATK.Conditional.YangMills.YMModel},   ATK.Termos.YM.ponteB7 M → ATK.Termos.YM.refutacao M → ¬ATK.Termos.YM.produtorO8 M

theorems.statement: ∀ (M : ATK.ClosedMath.Models),   ATK.Termos.RH.produtor →     ATK.Termos.Beal.produtor →       ATK.Termos.NS.ponteB3 M.ns →         ATK.Termos.NS.produtorO3 M.ns →           ATK.Termos.PNP.ponteB4 M.cx M.sat →             ATK.Termos.PNP.produtorO4 M.cx M.sat →               ATK.Termos.Hodge.ponteB5 M.hodge →                 ATK.Termos.Hodge.produtorO5 M.hodge →                   ATK.Termos.BSD.pon

theorems.statement: ∀ (M : ATK.ClosedMath.Models),   ATK.FinalRoot.Raiz M ↔     ATK.Termos.RH.produtor ∧       ATK.Termos.Beal.produtor ∧         ATK.Conditional.NavierStokes.ClayStatementA M.ns ∧           ATK.Conditional.PvsNP.PneNP M.cx ∧             (ATK.Termos.Hodge.ponteB5 M.hodge ∧ ATK.Termos.Hodge.produtorO5 M.hodge) ∧               (ATK.Termos.BSD.ponteB6 M.bsd ∧ ATK.Termos.BSD.produtorO6 M.bsd ∧ ATK.Termos.

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.D_rec
theorems.statement: ∀ (a0 a1 a2 : ℝ) (r : ℕ),   ATK.ToeplitzTN.Dtri a0 a1 a2 (r + 2) =     a1 * ATK.ToeplitzTN.Dtri a0 a1 a2 (r + 1) - a0 * a2 * ATK.ToeplitzTN.Dtri a0 a1 a2 r

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.Dmin_eq_submatrix
theorems.statement: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (r m : ℕ),   ATK.ClosedMath.Jensen.Dmin a r ↑m = ((ATK.ToeplitzTN.toep a).submatrix (fun i => m + ↑i) fun j => ↑j).det

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.Dmin_nonneg_de_raizes
theorems.statement: ∀ {p : Polynomial ℝ},   p.roots.card = p.natDegree →     (∀ x ∈ p.roots, x ≤ 0) → 0 ≤ p.leadingCoeff → ∀ (r m : ℕ), 0 ≤ ATK.ClosedMath.Jensen.Dmin (⇑p.coeff) r ↑m

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.Dmin_nonneg_of_tn
theorems.statement: ∀ {a : ℕ → ℝ}, (ATK.ToeplitzTN.toep a).IsTotallyNonneg → ∀ (r m : ℕ), 0 ≤ ATK.ClosedMath.Jensen.Dmin a r ↑m

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.Dtri_nonneg_of_tn
theorems.statement: ∀ {a0 a1 a2 : ℝ},   (ATK.ToeplitzTN.toep (ATK.ToeplitzTN.seq3 a0 a1 a2)).IsTotallyNonneg → ∀ (r : ℕ), 0 ≤ ATK.ToeplitzTN.Dtri a0 a1 a2 r

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.Dtri_one
theorems.statement: ∀ (a0 a1 a2 : ℝ), ATK.ToeplitzTN.Dtri a0 a1 a2 1 = a1

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.Dtri_shift
theorems.statement: ∀ (a0 a1 a2 : ℝ) (r : ℕ),   (Matrix.of fun i j => ATK.ToeplitzTN.tri a0 a1 a2 ↑i ↑j).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ =     Matrix.of fun i j => ATK.ToeplitzTN.tri a0 a1 a2 ↑i ↑j

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.Dtri_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ (a0 a1 a2 : ℝ), ATK.ToeplitzTN.Dtri a0 a1 a2 0 = 1

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.algum_D_neg
theorems.statement: ∀ {a0 a1 a2 : ℝ}, 0 < a0 → 0 < a2 → 0 ≤ a1 → a1 ^ 2 < 4 * a0 * a2 → ∃ r, ATK.ToeplitzTN.Dtri a0 a1 a2 r < 0

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.coeff_mul_lin
theorems.statement: ∀ (p : Polynomial ℝ) (r : ℝ), ⇑(p * (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C r)).coeff = ATK.ToeplitzTN.mulLin (⇑p.coeff) r

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.det_expand
theorems.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix ℕ ℕ ℝ) (rows cols : Fin n → ℕ) (r : ℝ),   (Matrix.of fun i j => r * A (rows i) (cols j) + A (rows i) (cols j + 1)).det =     ∑ β, (∏ i, ![r, 1] (β i)) * (A.submatrix rows fun j => cols j + ↑(β j)).det

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.mulLin.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (n : ℕ), ATK.ToeplitzTN.mulLin a r n = r * a n + if n = 0 then 0 else a (n - 1)

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.seq3.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (a0 a1 a2 : ℝ) (n : ℕ),   ATK.ToeplitzTN.seq3 a0 a1 a2 n = if n = 0 then a0 else if n = 1 then a1 else if n = 2 then a2 else 0

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.seq3_eq_coeff
theorems.statement: ∀ {a2 r1 r2 : ℝ},   ATK.ToeplitzTN.seq3 (a2 * (r1 * r2)) (a2 * (r1 + r2)) a2 =     ⇑(Polynomial.C a2 * (Multiset.map (fun x => Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C x) {r1, r2}).prod).coeff

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.tn_binomio_cubo
theorems.statement: (ATK.ToeplitzTN.toep ⇑((Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C 1) ^ 3).coeff).IsTotallyNonneg

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.tn_de_raizes
theorems.statement: ∀ {p : Polynomial ℝ},   p.roots.card = p.natDegree →     (∀ x ∈ p.roots, x ≤ 0) → 0 ≤ p.leadingCoeff → (ATK.ToeplitzTN.toep ⇑p.coeff).IsTotallyNonneg

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.tn_grau_dois_iff
theorems.statement: ∀ {a0 a1 a2 : ℝ},   0 < a0 →     0 < a2 → ((ATK.ToeplitzTN.toep (ATK.ToeplitzTN.seq3 a0 a1 a2)).IsTotallyNonneg ↔ 0 ≤ a1 ∧ 4 * a0 * a2 ≤ a1 ^ 2)

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.tn_mulLin
theorems.statement: ∀ {a : ℕ → ℝ},   (ATK.ToeplitzTN.toep a).IsTotallyNonneg →     ∀ {r : ℝ}, 0 ≤ r → (ATK.ToeplitzTN.toep (ATK.ToeplitzTN.mulLin a r)).IsTotallyNonneg

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.tn_prod
theorems.statement: ∀ (c : ℝ),   0 ≤ c →     ∀ (s : Multiset ℝ),       (∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ x) →         (ATK.ToeplitzTN.toep             ⇑(Polynomial.C c * (Multiset.map (fun x => Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C x) s).prod).coeff).IsTotallyNonneg

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.toep.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (i j : ℕ), ATK.ToeplitzTN.toep a i j = if j ≤ i then a (i - j) else 0

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.toep_C
theorems.statement: ∀ (c : ℝ), ATK.ToeplitzTN.toep ⇑(Polynomial.C c).coeff = c • 1

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.toep_mulLin
theorems.statement: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (i j : ℕ),   ATK.ToeplitzTN.toep (ATK.ToeplitzTN.mulLin a r) i j = r * ATK.ToeplitzTN.toep a i j + ATK.ToeplitzTN.toep a i (j + 1)

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.tri.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (a0 a1 a2 : ℝ) (i j : ℕ),   ATK.ToeplitzTN.tri a0 a1 a2 i j = if i = j then a1 else if i = j + 1 then a2 else if j = i + 1 then a0 else 0

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.tri_eq_toep
theorems.statement: ∀ (a0 a1 a2 : ℝ) (i j : ℕ),   ATK.ToeplitzTN.toep (ATK.ToeplitzTN.seq3 a0 a1 a2) (i + 1) j = ATK.ToeplitzTN.tri a0 a1 a2 i j

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.tri_succ
theorems.statement: ∀ (a0 a1 a2 : ℝ) (i j : ℕ), ATK.ToeplitzTN.tri a0 a1 a2 (i + 1) (j + 1) = ATK.ToeplitzTN.tri a0 a1 a2 i j

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.um_x_x2
theorems.statement: ATK.ToeplitzTN.Dtri 1 1 1 3 = -1

theorems.name: ATK.ToeplitzTN.um_x_x2_nao_tn
theorems.statement: ¬(ATK.ToeplitzTN.toep (ATK.ToeplitzTN.seq3 1 1 1)).IsTotallyNonneg

theorems.name: ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.cfg.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (l : Fin 2) (x A : List Bool),   ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.cfg l x A = { l := some l, var := (none, none), stk := ATK.ModeloPNP.pil x A }

theorems.name: ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.haltList_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (y : List Bool),   Turing.haltList ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.tm y = { l := none, var := (none, none), stk := ATK.ModeloPNP.pil y [] }

theorems.name: ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.initList_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (x : List Bool), Turing.initList ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.tm x = ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.cfg 0 x []

theorems.name: ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.one
theorems.statement: ∀ {c c' : ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.Cfg},   ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.step c = some c' → flip bind ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.step (some c) = some c'

theorems.name: ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.passo0.eq_1
theorems.statement: ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.passo0 =   Turing.TM2.Stmt.pop false (fun s o => (o, s.2))     (Turing.TM2.Stmt.branch (fun s => s.1.isSome)       (Turing.TM2.Stmt.push true (fun x => true)         (Turing.TM2.Stmt.push true (fun s => s.1.getD false)           (Turing.TM2.Stmt.push true (fun x => false)             (Turing.TM2.Stmt.load (fun x => (none, none)) (Turing.TM2.Stmt.goto fun x => 0)))))

theorems.name: ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.passo1.eq_1
theorems.statement: ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.passo1 =   Turing.TM2.Stmt.pop true (fun x o => (o, none))     (Turing.TM2.Stmt.branch (fun s => s.1.isSome)       (Turing.TM2.Stmt.push false (fun s => s.1.getD false)         (Turing.TM2.Stmt.load (fun x => (none, none)) (Turing.TM2.Stmt.goto fun x => 1)))       Turing.TM2.Stmt.halt)

theorems.name: ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.prog.eq_1
theorems.statement: ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.prog 0 = ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.passo0

theorems.name: ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.prog.eq_2
theorems.statement: ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.prog 1 = ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.passo1

theorems.name: ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.run0
theorems.statement: ∀ (x A : List Bool),   (flip bind ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.step)^[x.length + 1] (some (ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.cfg 0 x A)) =     some (ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.cfg 1 [] ((ATK.IntegracaoFCPNP.encFC x).reverse ++ A))

theorems.name: ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.run1
theorems.statement: ∀ (A B : List Bool),   (flip bind ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.step)^[A.length + 1] (some (ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.cfg 1 B A)) =     some { l := none, var := (none, none), stk := ATK.ModeloPNP.pil (A.reverse ++ B) [] }

theorems.name: ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.s0_cons
theorems.statement: ∀ (b : Bool) (r A : List Bool),   ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.step (ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.cfg 0 (b :: r) A) =     some (ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.cfg 0 r (false :: b :: true :: A))

theorems.name: ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.s0_nil
theorems.statement: ∀ (A : List Bool),   ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.step (ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.cfg 0 [] A) =     some (ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.cfg 1 [] A)

theorems.name: ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.s1_cons
theorems.statement: ∀ (B : List Bool) (a : Bool) (A : List Bool),   ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.step (ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.cfg 1 B (a :: A)) =     some (ATK.TranscodificadoresFC.M1.cfg 1 (a :: B) A)

theorems.name: ATK.YMReconstrucao.positividade_reflexao
theorems.statement: ∀ (β : ℝ) {k : ℕ} (c : Fin k → ℝ) (t : Fin k → ℕ), 0 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, c i * c j * ATK.YMToy.correl β (t i + t j)

theorems.statement: ∀ (β : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (a : Bool), ∑ b, ATK.YMToy.W β n a b * 1 = ATK.YMToy.C β ^ n

theorems.name: ATK.YMReconstrucao.vacuo_unico

theorems.statement: ∀ (θ : ℝ), ATK.YMSemGap.energia θ ≤ θ ^ 2

theorems.statement: ∀ (θ : ℝ), 0 ≤ ATK.YMSemGap.energia θ

theorems.statement: ∀ {θ : ℝ}, 0 < θ → θ < 2 * Real.pi → 0 < ATK.YMSemGap.energia θ

theorems.name: ATK.YMSemGap.forma_lap
theorems.statement: ∀ {L : ℕ} [inst : NeZero L] (f : ZMod L → ℝ), ∑ n, f n * ATK.YMSemGap.lapL f n = ∑ n, (f (n + 1) - f n) ^ 2

theorems.name: ATK.YMSemGap.forma_lap_nonneg
theorems.statement: ∀ {L : ℕ} [inst : NeZero L] (f : ZMod L → ℝ), 0 ≤ ∑ n, f n * ATK.YMSemGap.lapL f n

theorems.name: ATK.YMSemGap.forma_massiva
theorems.statement: ∀ {L : ℕ} [inst : NeZero L] (m : ℝ) (f : ZMod L → ℝ),   m ^ 2 * ∑ n, f n ^ 2 ≤ ∑ n, f n * (ATK.YMSemGap.lapL f n + m ^ 2 * f n)

theorems.name: ATK.YMSemGap.gap_massivo
theorems.statement: ∀ (m θ : ℝ) (n : ℤ),   ATK.YMSemGap.lap (fun k => Real.cos (θ * ↑k)) n + m ^ 2 * Real.cos (θ * ↑n) =       (m ^ 2 + ATK.YMSemGap.energia θ) * Real.cos (θ * ↑n) ∧     m ^ 2 ≤ m ^ 2 + ATK.YMSemGap.energia θ

theorems.name: ATK.YMSemGap.lap_cos
theorems.statement: ∀ (θ : ℝ) (n : ℤ), ATK.YMSemGap.lap (fun m => Real.cos (θ * ↑m)) n = ATK.YMSemGap.energia θ * Real.cos (θ * ↑n)

theorems.statement: ∀ (ε : ℝ),   0 < ε →     ∃ θ,       0 < θ ∧         θ < 2 * Real.pi ∧           0 < ATK.YMSemGap.energia θ ∧             ATK.YMSemGap.energia θ < ε ∧               ∀ (n : ℤ), ATK.YMSemGap.lap (fun m => Real.cos (θ * ↑m)) n = ATK.YMSemGap.energia θ * Real.cos (θ * ↑n)

theorems.name: ATK.YMSemGap.soma_desloc
theorems.statement: ∀ {L : ℕ} [inst : NeZero L] (g : ZMod L → ℝ) (a : ZMod L), ∑ n, g (n + a) = ∑ n, g n

theorems.name: ATK.YMToy.C_pos
theorems.statement: ∀ (β : ℝ), 0 < ATK.YMToy.C β

theorems.name: ATK.YMToy.S_lt_C
theorems.statement: ∀ (β : ℝ), ATK.YMToy.S β < ATK.YMToy.C β

theorems.name: ATK.YMToy.S_pos
theorems.statement: ∀ {β : ℝ}, 0 < β → 0 < ATK.YMToy.S β

theorems.name: ATK.YMToy.W.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (β : ℝ) (x x_1 : Bool), ATK.YMToy.W β 0 x x_1 = if x = x_1 then 1 else 0

theorems.name: ATK.YMToy.W.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ (β : ℝ) (x x_1 : Bool) (n : ℕ),   ATK.YMToy.W β n.succ x x_1 =     ATK.YMToy.W β n x true * ATK.YMToy.w β true x_1 + ATK.YMToy.W β n x false * ATK.YMToy.w β false x_1

theorems.statement: ∀ (β : ℝ) (x : ℕ) (x_1 x_2 : Bool),   ATK.YMToy.W β x x_1 x_2 =     match x, x_1, x_2 with     | 0, a, b => if a = b then 1 else 0     | n.succ, a, b => ATK.YMToy.W β n a true * ATK.YMToy.w β true b + ATK.YMToy.W β n a false * ATK.YMToy.w β false b

theorems.name: ATK.YMToy.correl.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ (β : ℝ) (n : ℕ), ATK.YMToy.correl β n = ATK.YMToy.G β n / ATK.YMToy.Z β n

theorems.name: ATK.YMToy.correl_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (β : ℝ) (n : ℕ), ATK.YMToy.correl β n = (ATK.YMToy.S β / ATK.YMToy.C β) ^ n

theorems.name: ATK.YMToy.correl_estado_zero

theorems.statement: ∀ (a b : ℤ), Relation.EqvGen ATK.ZeroClasses.Fronteira.Adj a b

theorems.statement: ∃ A, A.Nonempty ∧ (∀ x ∈ A, 1 - x ∈ A) ∧ ∀ x ∈ A, 0 < x ∧ x < 1 ∧ x ≠ 1 / 2
